response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for an ankle sprain that occurred during a trip in a natural environment. Clause A4.1 covers medical expenses abroad for acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication of pre-existing conditions (A5.1), planned treatment (A5.2), intentional injury (A11.1), alcohol or drug influence (A11.2), extreme sports (A11.3), or events related to war, terrorism, or nuclear incidents (A11.4)."}
